interface.longDescription: Set up a repository with guided configuration. Delegate code and knowledge tasks to separate branches, follow progress and review what comes back. Use document, data and evidence skills to produce and check artifacts. Requires the by CLI; delegation runs from a Branchyard-managed session. Optional artifact tools need their documented dependencies.
